rules.title: A change in one variant without its counterpart
rules.description: A change under one flavor or product-variant source set has no counterpart in the others, and the feature is not deliberately variant-specific. Not checked in single-variant repositories.

rules.title: Relies on an undeclared change of a shared library
rules.description: The change request relies on a change in a shared library (a new version, a new or changed symbol) and its Related Changes section has no entry for it. Which libraries are shared comes from the repository criteria.

rules.title: Uses API that a related change removes
rules.description: The change request still calls a symbol that a related change request removes or renames. Reported on this change request's lines.

rules.title: Misses an argument a related change requires
rules.description: A related change request adds a required parameter and the call sites of this change request do not pass it. Reported on this change request's lines.

rules.title: Uses a changed API against its new contract
rules.description: The change request uses an API changed by a related change request against its new contract: nullability, threading or error behaviour. Reported on this change request's lines.
